_comment: GET /game/12090 on opencritic-api.p.rapidapi.com, trimmed to the fields the
catalog reads. The RapidAPI documentation page renders its example response
in JavaScript and could not be fetched, so the field names here were taken
from two independent open-source clients of the same API on 2026-09-16 and
cross-checked against each other: the opencritic-mcp package, which calls
this RapidAPI listing and types GET /game/{id} with exactly these names, and
southern_light's opencritic_integration.ApiGame Go struct. The figures are
illustrative; the names are the part under test. The real response also
carries images, trailers, Platforms, Companies, Genres and more, which the
catalog ignores - the extra keys below stand in for that.
name: Elden Ring
